name: factory-panel
description: A pane beside the chat in the Claude desktop app that shows where a Black Factory run stands and what waits on the human. It reads only through the engine's read commands.

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: auto opens the pane by itself in a factory folder, command opens it only with /factory-panel, off draws nothing.

pollSeconds.title: Poll seconds
pollSeconds.description: How often the engine's event count is read while the pane or the status line is on screen. At least 3; 0 for off.

bf.title: Engine command
bf.description: The name of the engine's command, when it is not bf on the path.
